selected_process_card.title: Obstacle To Care
selected_process_card.why: The supplied reference is strongest when the tiny emotional obstacle is not the hill itself, but the fear of being slower, behind, or too much effort. Zuv must answer through behavior, not a speech.

routes.title: Love Stopped Feeling Like A Race
routes.universal_truth: The right love does not make your slower pace feel like failure.
routes.proof_engine: she tries to keep up -> he notices -> he stops for 'the view' -> he matches her steps -> they arrive together
routes.zuv_role: He notices her trying not to ask for help, invents a pause that protects her pride, and then walks at her speed.

routes.title: He Stopped For The View
routes.universal_truth: Some care is quiet enough to look like coincidence.
routes.proof_engine: steep path -> tired face -> he points at the view as cover -> water/hand offered without announcement -> together view
routes.zuv_role: He makes the pause feel natural so she never has to feel rescued.

routes.title: My Pace Became Our Pace
routes.universal_truth: Love is not always pushing; sometimes it is syncing.
routes.proof_engine: uneven steps -> adjusted stride -> shared bag/water -> same-level walking -> soft payoff
routes.zuv_role: He changes rhythm instead of telling her to hurry.

routes.title: Not Ahead, Not Behind
routes.universal_truth: A relationship should not make one person feel like they are catching up forever.
routes.proof_engine: two positions on path -> helping hand -> side-by-side final
routes.zuv_role: He makes physical space beside him.

routes.title: The One Who Waits Without Announcing It
routes.universal_truth: Some people make waiting feel like love, not pity.
routes.proof_engine: slow step -> quiet pause -> no lecture -> shoulder-to-shoulder ending
routes.zuv_role: He waits without making the waiting visible.

routes.title: Some Love Takes The Slower Road
routes.universal_truth: The slower road can feel safer with the right person.
routes.proof_engine: path choice -> slower route -> shared pause -> destination together
routes.zuv_role: He chooses the route with her, but the scene risks becoming travel-first.

routes.title: Main Kar Lungi, Bas Saath Chalna
routes.universal_truth: Some independence still wants a witness nearby.
routes.proof_engine: she refuses help -> he stays close -> no fuss -> side-by-side ending
routes.zuv_role: He respects her independence while staying reachable.
